description: This Java class implements the <if-instance-of> element for a mini language, providing conditional branching based on whether a field's value is an instance of a specified class. It includes validation, execution logic, and factory creation methods for this element within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: IfInstanceOf
classes.description: A class representing the <if-instance-of> element, providing logic to evaluate whether a specific field's value is an instance of a given class, and executing nested operations accordingly.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the conditional check and runs associated sub-operations based on the instance-of evaluation.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from nested operations for analysis.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the <if-instance-of> element.

factory.name: IfInstanceOfFactory
factory.description: Factory class for creating instances of IfInstanceOf from XML elements.
